usage_mode.title: Cost Budgets Mode
usage_mode.description: off - nothing is metered or blocked. observe - meter and evaluate limits without blocking. enforce - reject calls once a limit is exceeded.

usage_retention_months.title: Fact row retention (months)
usage_retention_months.description: How long usage_event rows are kept. Not yet acted on.

usage_partition_ahead_months.title: Partitions created ahead (months)
usage_partition_ahead_months.description: How many future monthly partitions of usage_event to pre-create.

usage_max_call_cost_usd.title: Max reserved cost per call (USD)
usage_max_call_cost_usd.description: Ceiling on one call's pre-flight cost estimate. Bounds how far spend can pass a limit.

usage_default_output_tokens.title: Assumed output tokens
usage_default_output_tokens.description: Output length assumed when a request does not declare max_tokens.

usage_reservation_ttl_seconds.title: Reservation lifetime (seconds)
usage_reservation_ttl_seconds.description: After this a reservation is reclaimed. Must exceed the LLM proxy's consumer timeout.

usage_queue_flush_batch_size.title: Queue flush batch size
usage_queue_flush_batch_size.description: Events written to the database per drainer tick.

usage_queue_flush_interval_seconds.title: Queue flush interval (seconds)
usage_queue_flush_interval_seconds.description: How often queued usage events are written out. Also the counter lag.

usage_queue_flush_max_batches_per_tick.title: Queue flush batches per tick
usage_queue_flush_max_batches_per_tick.description: Batches drained per tick, so a behind drainer can catch up. Bounded by the worker lease, not by throughput: do not raise past 8.

usage_reaper_interval_seconds.title: Reservation reaper interval (seconds)
usage_reaper_interval_seconds.description: How often expired reservations are reclaimed.

usage_lease_seconds.title: Worker lease (seconds)
usage_lease_seconds.description: How long one replica holds the right to drain and reap before another may take over.

usage_limits_cache_ttl_seconds.title: Limit cache TTL (seconds)
usage_limits_cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long effective budget limits are cached in each pylon before being re-read.

usage_project_warning_pct.title: Team Project Budget Warning Threshold (%)
usage_project_warning_pct.description: Show a usage alert when a team project's spend reaches this percentage of its budget limit.

usage_personal_project_warning_pct.title: Personal Project Budget Warning Threshold (%)
usage_personal_project_warning_pct.description: Show a usage alert when a user's own project spend reaches this percentage of its budget limit.

usage_user_warning_pct.title: Default Per-Member Budget Warning Threshold (%)
usage_user_warning_pct.description: Show a usage alert when a member's spend inside a team project reaches this percentage of their own budget limit.

usage_reconcile_repair_batch_size.title: Reconcile repair batch size
usage_reconcile_repair_batch_size.description: Counter rows repaired per transaction when the hourly reconciler applies a fix.
